subtitle: Special Lecture for Information and Computer Science 2
keywords: FE 2.Computer system 3.Files and databases 4.Network and security 5.System strategy and management strategy
educationalGoal: “Fundamental Information Technology Engineer Examination (FE)” is known as the gateway to success for new ICT engineers. The FE is divided into the first half and the second half on the test day, and it is necessary to pass both of the examinations at the same day. Students will learn the basic ICT skills to pass the first half of the FE exam.
advice: This is a basic countermeasure course to pass the first half of the FE exam. We will cover the following materials: 1. Computer basics 2. Radix conversion and complement 3. Computer components 4. Basic theory of computers 5. OS and middleware 6. System components 7. Multimedia technologies 8. Information Networks 9. Database systems Students are expected to bring their textbook and other necessary materials to every class. Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class and on a regular basis.
books: Textbooks: 1. WENet, "System development and computerization", Tokyo: WENet, 2020 2. WENet, "Introduction to computer systems", Tokyo: WENet, 2020 Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: This course requires the following knowledge/skills: 1. The units of “Programming 1”and “Programming 2” have been acquired. 2. The units of "Introduction to Engineering (Information and Computer Science)". 3. Knowledge of basic logical operation.

activityGoals.body: Be able to solve the problem of the first half of the FE exam.
Be able to explain the key points of the basic computer technologies.
Be able to explain the key points of the information networks.
Be able to explain the key points of the file systems and database systems.
Be able to explain the key points of the information security.
Be able to explain the key points of the computer system development technology.
